name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST With Prior Apprenticeship (Previous AY)
description: Same as 'Apprenticeship — Draft POST', but first creates and completes a different apprenticeship (standard 30) for the same learner/provider, due to end 2026-03-31 — AY 25/26, the previous academic year. The learner therefore already has one ApprenticeshipLearning row before the new draft POST (standard 21) is sent. Reproduces the FLP-1537 known bug: CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle calls ApprenticeshipLearningRepository.GetByLearnerKey unconditionally on every POST, and GetByLearnerKey is .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x => x.LearnerKey == key) — throws InvalidOperationException the moment a learner has more than one ApprenticeshipLearning row. No approval step for the new course — use the Commitments Fake UI to approve.

steps.name: Commitments Approves a Prior Apprenticeship, Standard 30, Ending 2026-03-31 (AY 25/26)
SLD Records Completion on the Prior Apprenticeship
SLD Create a New Draft Apprenticeship, Standard 21, Same Learner/Provider
